_description: Regression baseline metric definitions for syntheca pipeline outputs. These define the shape and expected ranges of quality metrics that should be tracked across pipeline runs. Actual baseline values will be populated after the first full pipeline run against a frozen input subset.

row_count.description: Expected row counts by output type

merged_final.note: Total rows in final merged output

doi_fill_rate.description: Percentage of records that have a non-null DOI
doi_fill_rate.note: Should remain stable unless source data changes

openalex_hit_rate.description: Percentage of Pure publications successfully matched to an OpenAlex work

org_mapping_coverage.description: Percentage of authors with at least one resolved organizational unit mapping
org_mapping_coverage.note: Resolving faculty/department affiliations through the Pure org hierarchy

unresolved_person_count.description: Count of persons that could not be resolved to any UT People page or org mapping
unresolved_person_count.note: Should decrease as disambiguation logic improves

title_fallback_count.description: Count of OpenAlex matches that used title-based fuzzy matching instead of DOI
title_fallback_count.note: Title matches are less reliable than DOI matches; track to identify drift
